title: Public Pathway Consolidation v5r1: repaired standalone mechanism core
summary: PPC5r1 is one hash-bound standalone causal core. It freezes THINK and ACT, trains only an isolated evidence-gated READ-LoRA, tests candidate-conditioned recognition and every-edge recurrent path use, and separately intervenes on frozen same-model DREAM as immediate context reconciliation and as root selection for SLEEP. Complete candidate tables are treated as external semantic support rather than evidence of closed-book storage. Learned DECIDE without final ACT targets is the immediate successor, followed by stream, schema, flywheel, and parenting stages.
system_thesis: An Experience Model should turn its own public action-outcome history into a durable per-life parametric worldview that changes future cognition. PPC5r1 tests a narrower identifiable link: whether an evidence-gated adapter causally improves supported-record selection from an external candidate set, whether a frozen recurrent thinker causally uses every returned edge in a decisive path, and whether frozen same-model DREAM improves working-context and SLEEP-root selection. It does not claim closed-book storage, learned thinking, continual improvement, compression, saturation, or parenting.

claims.after: The assigned per-life READ-LoRA causally improved selection of supported public records conditional on an external full semantic candidate table.
claims.evidence_needed: Life-level recognition, false-memory, and abstention under exact, reverse, paraphrase, and partial cues; adapter-off, wrong-life, root-shuffle, and external-candidate ceiling controls. No closed-book storage inference is permitted.

claims.after: A frozen recurrent thinker adaptively used every registered local record in a presealed decisive path to improve held-out action.
claims.evidence_needed: Ordered public opens/citations, every-edge cuts, directional binding twins, no replacement paths, open-loop and one-shot-query removals, and all conjunctive bypass baselines.

claims.after: Authentic same-model DREAM publication preserved more decision-relevant conscious state and improved subsequent work than equal-compute withhold and mismatched contexts.
claims.evidence_needed: Prospectively randomized context-pressure points, equal budgets, exact retained-state outcomes, downstream action value, contradiction recovery, and retained-item leave-one-out cuts.

claims.after: Authentic DREAM-selected roots produced more useful evidence-gated READ writes and later action than matched deterministic and cross-fitted root selections.
claims.evidence_needed: Same-lineage DREAM call/output in every branch, mechanical recipient-local selection, donor-rank recipient-local mismatch, intention-to-treat root census, fixed capacity ceilings, realized-dose mediators, candidate recognition, and later path/action value.

claims.after: A fully positive PPC5r1 establishes one finite public experience-to-DREAM-to-SLEEP-to-reader-to-action mechanism cycle, not closed-book storage, learned THINK, continual improvement, compression, saturation, parenting, or population learning.
claims.evidence_needed: All four literal PPC5r1 assays pass with exact status-specific audit and no claim exceeds the standalone protocol.
